versions.title: Lumi alpha 0.1.0-alpha.3
versions.summary:
Alpha 0.1.0-alpha.3 changes:
Improved live undo/redo ownership for TNT, explosions, redstone, and mob fallout.
Prevented replay-restored TNT from re-igniting through stale queued callbacks.
Added player-scoped undo/redo selection, native-tool verification, and queued shortcut handling.
Improved overlay performance, restore reliability, and localized UI coverage.
